problem_observed: The retained J-Space activation steering search could emit success=true after baseline, directional sign and zero-vector controls, while current supervisor-8.68 J-Space intervention law requires a clean/corrupted/target/sham/off-target causal family before model-specific causal promotion. A downstream consumer could therefore misread search success as causal credit unless the result carries an explicit evidence-class fence.
hypothesis: A steering search result should remain useful for locating candidate layer/alpha coordinates while being mechanically incapable of self-promoting into J-Space causal credit.
counterhypothesis: Existing prose that the module does not provide model hooks is sufficient to prevent downstream causal overclaiming.
discriminator: Make the evidence boundary explicit in the returned data object and regression-test the positive-success case. If success=true can coexist only with jspace_causal_credit=false and an exact list of missing controls, prose-only ambiguity is removed without deleting the useful steering search.

external_donor_corroboration.transformerlens: Activation patching uses clean versus corrupted runs and intervenes on intermediate activations to measure output recovery; this supports the need to distinguish causal intervention from generic steering search.
external_donor_corroboration.nnsight: Trace contexts permit reading and modifying intermediate activations during a forward pass; this supports the current gate requirement that the actual backend expose intervention-capable internal state rather than only final completions.
external_donor_corroboration.huggingface_transformers: output_hidden_states exposes per-layer hidden states for supported model outputs, providing an observation primitive but not by itself a causal intervention or loader-consumption attestation.

diagnostics.reason: No exact-source authorized local/clay-direct-dev executor was exposed; no GitHub workflow run existed for the exact donor head at observation time.

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED_BY_FUSION: avoided duplicate current-surface repair after parallel main landed 8.68 authority sync; retained the single donor lane and hardened its product-facing evidence semantics.
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED: reusable HCU/J-Space search result now carries explicit causal-credit and control-family boundary metadata.
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED: positive steering-search success can no longer be represented as model-specific J-Space causal credit without the missing corrupted/sham/off-target family.

next_exact_action: Implement or expose one actual zero-cost local intervention-capable backend on the retained path, then execute BASELINE_CLEAN + BASELINE_CORRUPTED + INTERVENTION_TARGET + SHAM_CONTROL + OFF_TARGET_CONTROL with exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/loader/model-execution/activation-site/InferenceReceipt identities.
